title: Contract and measurement summary
responsibility: Shows readable contract rows, size and performance facts.

inputs.name: EntitySummary.contract
inputs.description: Required prepared rows containing labels and either item lists or a value.

inputs.name: EntitySummary.measure
inputs.description: Required prepared size and performance rows including notes, environment, tolerance and over-policy flags.

inputs.name: EntitySummary.compact
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. True removes Purpose from contract rows and hides inline size notes while keeping tooltips.

inputs.name: EntitySummary.last
inputs.description: Optional parent commit identifying a removed entity’s last contract. Nonempty switches the heading and adds removal context.

outputs.name: EntitySummary
outputs.description: Contract, size and performance cards. Zero performance rows show unmeasured latency/memory and no-budget guidance; one row gets a fact layout, multiple rows a table. Uses supplied over flags for the above-5%-policy label; does not assess the policy itself.
